hint.en: Split out “Ann is mortal” and wire it into <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>使用<level-ref to="decl-ex"></level-ref>写下的引入规则：有对象满足某个条件，就可以说存在满足这个条件的对象。接入关于该对象的命题；若能得出多个存在命题，在元件上选择所需的结论。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> uses the introduction rule written in <level-ref to="decl-ex"></level-ref>: an object satisfying a condition shows that such an object exists. Connect a statement about the object; if several existential statements follow, choose the conclusion on the part.
